purpose: Controlled contract for AI question understanding and evidence-grounded reasoning.
rules: The AI may interpret but must not calculate or alter mechanical facts.
Every factual chart statement must be traceable to supplied evidence.
Source knowledge must retain source IDs and locators.
Interpretation must be distinguishable from mechanical fact.
If supplied evidence is insufficient, the system must say so rather than invent facts.
Connection interpretation cannot assert dominance, compatibility, attraction, or relationship quality as mechanical facts.
Temporal claims require supplied temporal evidence; the AI must not infer astronomical timing.
